baseline: Corrected benchmark-v1.1 inherited unchanged via revision01

new_requested_facts: Shuffle the 9 Bonus tiles and place 1 random face-up tile on each of the 4 blank yellow spaces, leaving the two printed-icon spaces uncovered.
Return the other 5 tiles to the box.
If a component runs out, use a suitable substitute.
Each player may take 2 random maps and choose an advanced side, or lay out player count plus 1 advanced maps and choose in reverse turn order; return unused maps.
Map A starts with an empty size-3 standard enclosure on its indicated spaces and its printed kiosk is already built.
You may build adjacent to that kiosk.
accepted_candidates.source_references: Main pp4,6; FAQ p2 Map A; Main p6 map illustration

new_requested_facts: Seven player tokens cover the seven bonus spaces at the left edge of the zoo map; the other player tokens are personal supply.
Hire inactive workers from the lowest occupied storage space upward, moving them to the notepad as active.
Some maps grant conservation points for hiring the last worker.
Flip one chosen side-I card to side II in its current slot.
Use the improved action from the next action onward, even if the upgrade occurred during that action; it immediately satisfies upgraded-card conditions.
Four upgrade opportunities are the conservation track, reputation track, second partner zoo and second university, with an alternative at one opportunity, so all five cannot be upgraded.
accepted_candidates.source_references: Main p8 upgrade paragraphs; FAQ p2 Other

new_requested_facts: At strengths 1/2/3/4/5 draw 1/1/2/2/3 cards respectively, then discard 1/0/1/0/1 respectively.
A required discard may be a newly drawn card or an older hand card.
accepted_candidates.source_references: Main p2 Action-card table / p8 miniature table and p9 Drawing from the deck

new_requested_facts: At strengths 1/2/3/4/5 draw 1/2/2/3/4 cards respectively, then discard 0/1/0/1/1 respectively.
accepted_candidates.source_references: Main p2 Action-card table / p8 miniature table; Main p9

new_requested_facts: Animals I permits 0/1/1/1/2 animals at strengths 1/2/3/4/5 respectively.
A zero-animal regular action cannot be chosen because doing nothing is prohibited.
Animals II permits up to 1/1/2/2/2 animals at strengths 1/2/3/4/5 respectively.
At strength 5 or higher, Animals II may gain 1 reputation at the very beginning of the action.
accepted_candidates.source_references: Main p2 Action-card tables (Animals II visible strengths 4–5), Main pp8,11,13; accepted numeric-only original component supplement: original publisher Spielzene.jpg and 2021 Back_arche_nova.jpg matching original German component artwork, recorded in table-source-check/followup-source-report.json; coordinator-supplied ark-nova-original-physical-animals-II.png is a third-party 2022 review photograph of an original German card and is corroborating research history only; original English base scope retained

new_requested_facts: The seven categories are bird, herbivore, predator, primate, reptile, bear and Petting Zoo animal.
Bear and Petting Zoo animal count unless explicitly excluded.
A bear icon may occur with herbivore or predator icons and does not replace them; Petting Zoo is its own game category.
Only an upgraded Association action allows a donation, and at least 1 association task must have been performed during that same action.
At most 1 donation is allowed per Association action and no additional worker is required.
The printed cost ladder is 2, 5, 5, 7, 7, 10, 10, then repeatable 12 money, with setup-blocked spaces unavailable.
Pay the lowest still-visible donation amount and cover it with a token from personal supply, gaining 1 conservation point.
Once only the last donation space remains, each donation costs 12 money without placing further tokens.
accepted_candidates.source_references: Main p16 Association II donation paragraphs; Main p14 Association-board donation diagram

new_requested_facts: Count upper-right icons on your Animal and Sponsor cards and icons on your partner zoos and universities.
Water and rock requirements at the upper-left of Animal and unique-building cards count too.
Left-side play conditions and conservation-project icons do not count.
The card itself counts for both immediate and recurring effects; duplicate icons count and trigger effects twice.
Card text overrides conflicting general rules.
accepted_candidates.source_references: Glossary p1 Golden Rules; Main pp11,17; FAQ p3 continent icons

new_requested_facts: The building must actually share edges with two distinct terrain hexes; one building hex may touch both.
Multiple building hexes touching the same terrain hex still count only once.
Adjacency to one hex of a connected two-hex water area is adjacency to only one water hex.
Water/rock illustrations on buildings and standard enclosures do not count as terrain requirements or terrain spaces.
accepted_candidates.source_references: Glossary p1 Double Icons; FAQ p2 Zoo maps/Other

new_requested_facts: Playing a Release into the Wild project from hand (or permitted display play) grants 1 reputation; supporting a project already in play does not grant that play bonus.
Breeding Program cards 123–127 have the same condition for all three spaces, so choose any free space and receive its depicted reward.
The left side is the condition and the right side its reward.
With no number, or with per, receive the reward once for each fulfillment.
With one or more numbers on the left, receive only one reward; with several thresholds, use the highest fulfilled threshold.
A connected space is not itself covered and is adjacent to at least 1 covered space.
An isolated space is not adjacent to a covered space.
A border space lacks another map space along at least 1 of its 6 sides.
Your zoo comprises your card display, map contents and personal supply.
Any zoo combines these for all players.
accepted_candidates.source_references: Glossary p4 Term Definitions; FAQ p3 border space

new_requested_facts: You must place the matching unique-building tile when playing its card; if legal placement is impossible, you cannot play that card.
No building money cost is paid.
Apply usual building rules, keep the colored matching-icon side up, rotate freely but do not flip.
Unique buildings are not enclosures, cannot house additional animals, and never count as water or rock spaces.
First finish the Animals action including moving Animals to slot 1.
Perform the granted action using the relevant own Action card normally and then move it to slot 1.
A named Action cannot be replaced by taking an X-token.
Determination permits any action, including the X-token action.
accepted_candidates.source_references: Glossary p2 Action/Determination; FAQ p3 final question

new_requested_facts: Search the face-down remaining base-project pile: Assertion chooses a card, Dominance takes its named card; add it to hand and return the pile.
Dominance does nothing if the named card is already in play.
Later play and support the acquired card using Association, above the board with normal played projects, not below with the setup base projects.
Resolve after finishing Animals and moving its card to slot 1.
Boost moves the named Action card to slot 1 or 5; Clever puts the chosen card into slot 1.
Moving to 1 shifts cards previously to its left one slot right; moving to 5 shifts cards previously to its right one slot left.
accepted_candidates.source_references: Glossary p2 Boost/Clever; FAQ p1 Boost

new_requested_facts: Only zoos with at least 5 appeal can be affected.
The acting player may resolve that animal appeal before or after the interactive ability, so normally its appeal need not count during target selection.
The group may use the printed alternate solo effects instead of interactive effects without removing the cards.
accepted_candidates.source_references: Main p11; Glossary pp2–3 interactive ability reminders; FAQ p1

new_requested_facts: Constriction 1 targets the card in slot 5; Constriction 2 targets slots 4 and 5.
A card can have at most 1 Constriction token; return duplicate tokens.
Its action has strength reduced by 2, applying to both actions if multiplied, and X-tokens may raise strength.
Return the used token after the action, or unused tokens during the next break.
Its regular action has strength −1 or 0 and cannot be performed as is.
Spend enough X-tokens to reach at least strength 1, wait until it reaches slot 3, or use the alternative X-token action if below the holding cap.
Choose separately after each card which option to use next.
If you discard a display card, immediately shift higher-folder cards down as needed and replenish, placing the new card in folder 6.
If another herbivore in your zoo requires an equal or larger standard enclosure, play the flock animal without flipping an enclosure.
The host may itself be flock or non-flock and can host any number of flock animals.
Without a suitable existing herbivore, occupy an enclosure normally; a later non-flock herbivore cannot move into that same enclosure.
Releasing a flock animal still permits freeing an occupied enclosure without proving it originally occupied one.
accepted_candidates.source_references: Glossary p2 Flock Animal; release procedure as in Q17

new_requested_facts: Move 1 worker from the lowest occupied storage space to the notepad, making it available immediately.
Apply any map bonus for hiring the last worker.
If all workers are already hired, it has no effect.
Discard all revealed cards and take none.
Among tied highest-appeal eligible zoos choose the affected player; if that is yourself, the ability has no effect.
Use your own X-tokens to raise strength.
Use the target Action card side for the entire copied action, while all other Action-card sides are your own.
Move the used target Action card to slot 1 normally.
Constriction and Venom on it affect you and are discarded afterwards; its Multiplier cannot be used.
Copied upgraded Build allows its special enclosures and upgrade-marked map spaces even if your Build is I; copied upgraded Animals allows upgrade-conditioned animals even if yours is I.
Copied Association I cannot take a third partner zoo even if your own Association is II.
When copied Sponsors plays a unique building, your own Build side determines permission for upgrade-marked map spaces.
Immediately place the token on its named Action card; a bonus-tile Multiplier may go on any Action card, including Animals.
Next use may execute that action twice in succession at the same base strength, then move the card to slot 1.
Each spent X-token strengthens only one of the two actions.
Resolve after-finishing effects only after both actions.
You may choose different normal options of that action each time; a break triggered by the first waits until the complete turn ends.
Return the token after use or unused at the next break.
Multiple Multiplier tokens may share a card; each adds 1 extra action, so 2 tokens permit up to 3 actions.
A Multiplier may be used for 2 X-token actions, subject to the holding limit.
It cannot combine 1 X-token action and 1 regular action.
Peacocking can place the Large Bird Aviary before Build is upgraded, but only if a legal site exists and the zoo does not already have one.
Other normal building rules still apply, including upgrade-marked map spaces.
Posturing follows normal placement rules, including kiosk distance; multiple buildings are placed one after another.
accepted_candidates.source_references: Glossary p3 Peacocking/Posturing; FAQ p1 map upgrade restriction

new_requested_facts: The first gains 3 appeal, the second 6 and the third 9.
At most 3 Petting Zoo animals can be held because only 1 Petting Zoo is allowed.
They count as small animals.
Choose among tied eligible zoos with highest appeal or most conservation as specified.
Most-conservation targeting requires at least 1 conservation point.
If the affected player is yourself, the ability has no effect.
accepted_candidates.source_references: Glossary p3 Pilfering; FAQ p1 Japanese Macaque

new_requested_facts: The affected player chooses a random hand-card draw (excluding Final Scoring cards) or paying 5 money.
With no hand cards they must pay 5; with less than 5 money they must allow a hand-card draw.
With neither hand cards nor 5 money, give all remaining money, possibly zero.
Repeated pilferings resolve sequentially, with a fresh choice after each result.
Pouched cards no longer function.
If that animal is released, discard its tucked cards but retain appeal already gained.
Sold Sunbathing cards go to the discard pile.
Resistance can give an extra Final Scoring card.
If obtained before anyone reaches 10 conservation, choose any one of all your Final Scoring cards to discard when that threshold is first reached.
Score all Final Scoring cards you still hold at the end, each subject to its own 4-conservation cap.
Shuffle the discard pile face down and draw randomly from it, then return the pile face up.
Snapping must take a display card, ignoring reputation, and cannot draw from the deck.
Sponsor Magnet ignores reputation for Sponsor cards in the display; if there are none it has no effect.
Replenish the display at the end of the turn.
accepted_candidates.source_references: Glossary p3 Snapping/Sponsor Magnet; Main p9

new_requested_facts: Place tokens on the lowest-slot Action cards starting at slot 1; at most 1 Venom token per card and return duplicates.
Using a marked card removes its token and suppresses effects of Venom on your other cards that turn.
If no Venom token was removed that turn and any remains on a card at turn end, pay 2 money.
If unable to pay, undo the turn and choose a different action; spending all money does not avoid payment.
Remove remaining Venom tokens without effect at the next break.
Yes, use the marked card for the X-token action and discard its Venom token.
You cannot choose the X-token action when already holding 5 X-tokens.
On play and in every break income phase, you may take a display card in reputation range or draw a deck card.
At final scoring gain 1 conservation for 3–5 research icons or 2 for 6 or more.
Each research icon played into your zoo gains 1 reputation.
Its own research icon triggers it immediately when played.
accepted_candidates.source_references: Glossary p4 Spokesperson 202; p1 Cards Always Count Themselves

new_requested_facts: Gain 2/5/10 money for 1/2/3 universities respectively when played.
Supporting a conservation project through Association requires strength 4 instead of 5.
Gain 1 conservation at final scoring if you have 3 universities.
On play gain 2 money per research icon in your zoo.
Each research icon played into your zoo gains 1 conservation point.
Gain 2 appeal for every conservation project already supported, counted by missing tokens from the left of your map.
Gain 1 conservation in each break income phase.
Count different animal-category and continent icons, not repeated copies of an icon or research icons.
Gain 1 conservation per 2 different icons, rounding down.
Every other player gains 2 money per conservation point gained this way.
On play gain 1 appeal per research icon in your zoo.
Whenever a research icon is played in any zoo, gain 2 money.
At final scoring gain 1 conservation if you have at least 5 different animal-category icons.
On play and in each break income phase gain 1 X-token, subject to the cap of 5.
At final scoring gain 1 conservation if you have 3 universities.
On play gain 1 appeal per Americas icon in your zoo.
Each Americas icon played into your zoo lets you place 1 kiosk for free, following normal building rules including kiosk spacing.
Gain 1 conservation at final scoring for 5 or more kiosks.
accepted_candidates.source_references: Glossary p5 Expert on the Americas 210

new_requested_facts: On play gain 1 appeal per Europe icon in your zoo.
Each Europe icon played into your zoo lets you place a 1-space enclosure for free under normal building rules.
Gain 1 conservation at final scoring for at least 5 occupied 1-space enclosures.
On play gain 1 appeal per Australia icon in your zoo.
Each Australia icon played into your zoo lets you place 1 hand card beneath this Sponsor to gain 2 appeal.
The tucked card has no further function.
On play gain 1 appeal per Asia icon in your zoo.
Each Asia icon played into your zoo lets you place 1 pavilion for free, following normal building rules.
On play gain 1 appeal per Africa icon in your zoo.
Each Africa icon played into your zoo lets you put any Action card in slot 1 after finishing the current action, after the used card has already moved to slot 1.
At final scoring gain 1 appeal per X-token in personal supply.
Place 2 tokens from personal supply on the card when played.
When supporting a base project below the Association board, return exactly 1 token as any needed icon; never use both on the same project.
A base card later played above the board does not qualify.
At final scoring gain 1 conservation for supporting projects 5 or more times, counted by missing map tokens.
Card 218 has different play conditions but otherwise works identically.
accepted_candidates.source_references: Glossary p5 Global Breeding Program 215 / Breeding Program 218

new_requested_facts: Immediately hire 1 worker from the lowest occupied storage space, available at once, applying any final-worker map reward; if all are hired this part has no effect.
Gain 1 conservation at final scoring if reputation is at least 9.
Each Build action may build exactly 1 extra copy of one building built by that action without requiring extra strength.
Pay its normal money cost and obey normal placement rules.
With multiple original buildings, choose only 1 to duplicate; special enclosures cannot be duplicated.
Gain 5 appeal at final scoring if all map building spaces are covered, excluding rock and water.
On play gain 2 money per water and rock icon in your zoo, including icons on cards 241/242 and terrain requirements.
You may cover water and rock map spaces, but need not cover them for map completion.
Ignore water and rock requirements when playing animals and unique buildings, while their printed icons still count.
Covered terrain no longer counts for Hydrologist 241, Geologist 242 or Architectural Zoo 004.
At final scoring gain 2 appeal per set of 1 water icon and 1 rock icon, maximum 3 sets.
Gain 3 money on play and in each break income phase.
At final scoring gain 1 conservation if reputation is at least 9.
Each placement bonus gained on a border space triggers an additional free placement bonus of your choice.
Choose any still-uncovered placement bonus anywhere on your map, including away from the border.
Multiple simultaneous border bonuses each grant an extra; those extras may choose the same or different eligible bonuses, and all bonuses resolve in your chosen order.
Gain 1 conservation at final scoring if all border building spaces are covered, excluding water and rock.
Gain 1 conservation per research icon in your zoo, maximum 3.
Each other player gains 2 money for every conservation point gained this way.
On play gain 1 X-token subject to the cap.
Each supported Release into the Wild project 113–122 gives 1 additional conservation.
You may support the same release project repeatedly by releasing another qualifying animal, but may put only 1 support token on a given project per Association action.
Each support token counts as a separately supported project for other effects.
On play gain 1 X-token subject to the cap.
Venom, Constriction, Hypnosis and Pilfering do not affect you.
Hypnosis or Pilfering instead targets the next player meeting its criterion, if possible, ignoring your track counters.
Gain 1 conservation at final scoring for all 5 continent icons in your zoo.
Choose small or large for the rest of the game and mark its box with a supply token.
Reveal deck cards until an Animal of that type appears, add it to hand, and discard the rest.
Every played chosen-type animal gives 2 appeal if small or 4 if large.
You may no longer play animals of the unchosen type.
Small means printed standard size 1–2 or Petting Zoo animal; large means standard size 4–5.
Size-3 animals remain legal but receive no bonus.
On play gain 2 money per small animal in your zoo.
If every animal played in the Animals action was small (size 1–2 or Petting Zoo), you may play 1 additional small animal from hand at normal cost and requirements.
Afterwards add 1 small animal from the display to hand if available, ignoring reputation.
This display take is allowed even if you decline the additional hand animal; a mixed small/large action does not qualify.
accepted_candidates.source_references: Glossary p6 WAZA Small Animals Program 228; FAQ p1

new_requested_facts: 229 gives 1 appeal per small animal on play and reduces the printed animal cost by 3 whenever playing a small animal.
Small animals have printed standard size 1–2 or are Petting Zoo animals.
230 gives 2 appeal per large animal on play and a 4-money discount for each played large animal.
Large animals have printed standard size 4–5.
accepted_candidates.source_references: Glossary p6 Experts in Small/Large Animals 229–230

new_requested_facts: On play gain 1 appeal per matching category icon in your zoo.
Each break gain 3 money for 1–2 matching icons, 6 for 3–4 or 9 for 5 or more; use one tier.
231 Primates uses primate icons; 232 Reptiles uses reptile; 233 Vultures uses bird; 234 Lions uses predator; 235 Elephants uses herbivore.
Each matching icon played in any zoo gives the card owner 3 money per icon.
The corresponding categories are primate, reptile, bird, predator and herbivore respectively.
On play gain 1 appeal per water icon in your zoo, including its own and printed water requirements.
Each newly covered map space adjacent to water gives 1 money, including each qualifying space of a multi-space build.
Multiple water neighbors do not multiply the reward for one covered space.
Gain 1 conservation at final scoring if every water space is connected to at least one covered space.
On play gain 3 appeal per 2 rock icons, rounding down, including its own and printed rock requirements.
Each newly covered space adjacent to rock gives 1 money, counting all qualifying spaces of a building but never multiplying one space for several rock neighbors.
Gain 1 conservation at final scoring if every rock space is connected to at least one covered space.
Meerkat Den must touch at least 1 rock; every herbivore icon played into your zoo gives 2 appeal; at least 6 herbivore icons gives 1 final conservation.
Penguin Pool must touch at least 1 water; every bird icon played into your zoo gives 2 appeal; at least 6 bird icons gives 1 final conservation.
Baboon Rock must touch at least 1 rock; every primate icon played into your zoo gives 2 appeal; at least 6 primate icons gives 1 final conservation.
accepted_candidates.source_references: Glossary p6 Meerkat Den 243 / Penguin Pool 244 / Baboon Rock 247

new_requested_facts: Aquarium must touch at least 2 distinct water spaces, gives 2 appeal per water icon played into your zoo, and scores 1 final conservation for at least 6 water icons.
Aerial Cableway must touch at least 2 distinct rock spaces, gives 2 appeal per rock icon played into your zoo, and scores 1 final conservation for at least 6 rock icons.
Icons on Hydrologist/Geologist and upper-left printed requirements qualify.
accepted_candidates.source_references: Glossary p6 Aquarium 245 / Aerial Cableway 246; p1 Double Icons

new_requested_facts: Place its unique-building tile under normal rules.
Each primate icon played into your zoo gives 1 X-token, subject to the cap of 5.
Place its unique-building tile under normal rules.
Each bird icon played into your zoo draws 2 deck cards; keep 1 and discard the other (Perception 2).
Place its unique building adjacent to at least 1 water space.
Each reptile icon played into your zoo allows sale of up to 2 hand cards for 4 money each.
Discard sold cards.
Place its unique building adjacent to at least 1 water.
Every bear icon played into any zoo gives you 2 appeal.
At final scoring gain 1 conservation for 3–5 bear icons in your zoo or 2 for 6 or more.
Appeal gained on another player turn cannot trigger your game end until the end of your own turn or a break.
accepted_candidates.source_references: Glossary p6 Polar Bear Exhibit 251; FAQ p1

new_requested_facts: Place its unique building adjacent to at least 1 rock.
Each predator icon played into your zoo triggers Hunter with X equal to all predator icons now in your zoo.
Reveal X deck cards, keep 1 revealed Animal and discard the rest; if none is an Animal discard all.
A newly played double predator icon triggers twice sequentially, with both new icons counting for X both times.
Place its unique building and put 3 personal-supply tokens on the card.
Each herbivore icon played into your zoo may spend 1 token to play 1 Sponsor from hand, paying money equal to its level and otherwise following normal play requirements.
This may trigger immediately from Okapi Stable itself.
It can be used at most 3 times from its 3 tokens.
Gain 1 reputation and 1 conservation.
Place its unique building covering at least 2 border spaces.
Take 1 display card in reputation range or draw 1 deck card; simultaneous effects may be ordered to raise reputation before choosing the card.
accepted_candidates.source_references: Glossary p7 Zoo School 254; p1 Order example

new_requested_facts: Place its unique building on 2 border spaces, without requiring adjacency to existing buildings; follow other placement rules.
Future buildings may be placed adjacent to it.
During income gain 2 money per adjacent building except empty standard enclosures; Side Entrance may itself be adjacent to a kiosk.
Gain 5 final appeal if all building spaces are covered, excluding water and rock.
Native Seabirds gives 1 appeal per connected water space on play and 1 final conservation per 2 isolated water spaces, rounding down.
Native Lizards applies the same pattern to rock spaces.
Connected means adjacent to a covered space; isolated means no such neighbor.
accepted_candidates.source_references: Glossary p7 Native Seabirds 258 / Native Lizards 259; p4 definitions

new_requested_facts: On play gain 1 appeal per connected but uncovered border building space.
Water and rock spaces do not qualify; upgrade-marked building spaces do.
At final scoring each contiguous group of empty building spaces scores 1 conservation per 6 spaces, rounded down separately for each group.
Count unbuildable-yet upgrade-marked spaces as empty building spaces; groups of sizes 13,6,3,2 score 3 conservation total.
accepted_candidates.source_references: Glossary p7 Native Farm Animals 260; FAQ p1

new_requested_facts: Gain 1 conservation and 1 appeal when played.
Gain 1 final conservation with at least 5 animal-category icons in your zoo, including bear and Petting Zoo animal categories.
On play gain 2 money per different continent or animal-category icon in your zoo, including bear/Petting Zoo and excluding research.
Each continent or category newly introduced to your zoo later gives 1 appeal and 2 money.
A card with 2 of the same newly introduced icon gives that bonus only once.
You may place a 5-space standard enclosure for free under normal building rules.
When playing a large animal (printed standard size 4–5), ignore one condition of your choice, such as one required icon or the Animals-upgrade condition.
Rock and water requirements cannot be ignored.
It stacks with active Research Institute, allowing two conditions to be ignored for a large animal.
accepted_candidates.source_references: Glossary p7 WAZA Large Animal Program 263

new_requested_facts: On play gain 1 appeal per connected space bearing a placement bonus.
At final scoring gain 1 conservation per 2 isolated spaces bearing placement bonuses, rounding down.
accepted_candidates.source_references: Glossary p7 Free-Range New World Monkeys 264

new_requested_facts: 3/6/8/10 Sponsor cards in your zoo give 1/2/3/4 conservation respectively, using the highest fulfilled tier.
accepted_candidates.source_references: Main p19 Final Scoring Card Layout, Sponsored Zoo 008 illustration

new_requested_facts: Gain 1 conservation for each animal-category icon of which you have more than the player to your right, counting icons in both zoos including Animal and Sponsor cards.
If that player has none of a category, 1 of that category is enough.
Bear and Petting Zoo categories count under the normal category rule.
Maximum 4 conservation from the card.
accepted_candidates.source_references: Main p19 Biodiverse Zoo 009 illustration; Glossary p8 009; Main p13 animal categories

new_requested_facts: The standard enclosure must touch the tower space itself, not merely another rock space.
Special enclosures do not benefit.
After release empties a qualifying enclosure, accommodating a new animal there grants the 2 appeal again.
The tower is not a building, including for kiosk income.
The standard enclosure must touch the Outdoor Area space itself, not merely another water space.
After placement treat that enclosure as 2 spaces larger for all purposes, including release and relocation; you cannot elect to ignore the increase.
Special enclosures do not benefit.
The Outdoor Area is not a building, including for kiosks.
accepted_candidates.source_references: Glossary p8 Map 2 Outdoor Areas; FAQ p2

new_requested_facts: Activate by placing a building on its adjacent building space.
Your first building may be placed there but need not be.
Its ability may be used before, during or after your action on your own turn, at most 1 discarded card per turn.
It cannot be used during another player turn or a break.
The Harbor itself is not a building, including for kiosks.
Each break gives 1 money per adjacent space with a building on it, including several spaces of the same building.
All building types and both empty and occupied enclosures qualify.
The Restaurant itself is not a building for kiosk income.
Its special-enclosure bonus places 1 of the 2 depicted special enclosures for free, even before Build is upgraded; it does not place both.
accepted_candidates.source_references: Glossary p8 Map 5 Park Restaurant; FAQ p2 Map 5

new_requested_facts: Activate when a building is placed on its adjacent building space; the first building may be placed there but need not be.
You may play an animal while 1 condition short, satisfying all other conditions.
The waiver may remove 1 required category icon or the Animals-upgrade condition but cannot remove water or rock requirements.
The Institute itself is not a building, including for kiosks.
After all indicated placement-bonus spaces are covered, each kiosk on the map gives 1 additional money each break.
Kiosks qualify regardless of how they were built and even if they produce no ordinary adjacency income.
accepted_candidates.source_references: Glossary p8 Map 7 Ice Cream Parlors

new_requested_facts: Cover H spaces like normal spaces, then reveal deck cards until a Sponsor appears; add it to hand and discard the other revealed cards.
This is similar to but is not a placement bonus, so it does not trigger Archaeologist.
After all 3 H spaces are covered, each Sponsor card level is 1 lower when you play it.
Bonus partner zoos still require Association II for the third/fourth slot, and bonus buildings still cannot cover upgrade-marked spaces before Build II.
accepted_candidates.source_references: Glossary p8 Map 8 Hollywood Hills; FAQ p2 Map 8

new_requested_facts: The second partner zoo grants an Action-card upgrade, the third hires an association worker, and the fourth grants 2 conservation points.
Association II remains required for the third and fourth partner slots regardless of acquisition by task, Bonus tile or Hollywood Hills bonus.
accepted_candidates.source_references: Main pp6–7 Map A diagram/right edge; FAQ pp1–2 partner bonus restrictions

new_requested_facts: The three tile options give 2 research icons; 1 research icon plus 2 reputation; or hand limit 5 plus 1 reputation.
The second university slot on Map A grants an Action-card upgrade.
accepted_candidates.source_references: Main p14 Association-board tile diagrams; Main p6 Map A right-edge diagram; Main p8 upgrade opportunities

new_requested_facts: Petting Zoo has capacity 3; Reptile House has capacity 5; Large Bird Aviary has capacity 5.
Capacity is marked by player tokens and must cover the animal special-enclosure requirement.
Building footprints are size 3,5,5 respectively.
Pay money equal to the Sponsor level and fulfill its usual conditions.
Play only from hand, even with Sponsors II.
The Sponsors Action card remains in its current slot and does not move.
accepted_candidates.source_references: FAQ p1 Icons, Sponsor-for-money bonus; accepted official base Icon Overview p2 top-right

new_requested_facts: No further points of that type are gained: maximum 113 appeal and 41 conservation.
Venom affects every eligible zoo with strictly higher appeal than yours.
Hypnosis affects the eligible zoo with highest appeal (no effect if yourself), and may perform its action only from slot 1, 2 or 3.

Pilfering 1 affects the highest-appeal zoo; Pilfering 2 affects the highest-appeal zoo and the zoo with most conservation, applying each target separately (twice if the same zoo qualifies for both); a self target has no effect.
Constriction affects all eligible zoos ahead of yours on appeal and/or conservation; each gets 1 token if ahead on 1 track, or 2 tokens if ahead on both.
Normal eligibility of at least 5 appeal and tie-selection rules still apply.
